newsitem.title: IRAN: Syrian vice-president Khaddam arrives in Tehran.
newsitem.headline: Syrian vice-president Khaddam arrives in Tehran.

text.p: Syrian vice-president Abdel-Halim Khaddam arrived in Tehran on Sunday for talks on bilateral relations, officials said.
Khaddam was met at Tehran's airport by Vice-President Hassan Habibi and Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati, they said.

Officials in Damascus said earlier that Khaddam, who was accompanied by Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara and several other ministers, would attend meetings of the joint Syrian-Iranian commission assigned to coordinate and promote bilateral cooperation.

Khaddam's visit follows harsh criticism by Iran's media of Syria's approval of a decision by Arab ministers backing the United Arab Emirates (UAE) in its dispute with Iran over ownership of three islands in the Gulf.
Syria backed Iran during its 1980-1988 war with Iraq.
